# PolyTrack Online

> Play PolyTrack online for free in the browser: a low-poly 3D racing game with a
> built-in track editor, community tracks, ghost replays, online leaderboards and
> multiplayer lobbies. No download, no account, no install.

PolyTrack is created by Kodub. This site is an unofficial fan mirror that hosts
version 0.6.3 of the official web build as static files, plus written guides.

## Play

- [Play PolyTrack](https://polytrack-labs.github.io/) — the game loads in the
  page; keyboard controls are W A S D or the arrow keys.

## Guides

- [How to Play](https://polytrack-labs.github.io/how-to-play/) — the rules of a
  run, checkpoints, ghost replays and the habits that make you faster.
- [Controls](https://polytrack-labs.github.io/controls/) — every key binding,
  including camera, pause and track editor shortcuts.
- [Track Editor](https://polytrack-labs.github.io/track-editor/) — building,
  testing and sharing custom tracks.
- [Unblocked](https://polytrack-labs.github.io/unblocked/) — why the game runs
  on restricted school and work networks, and how to fix a game that will not start.

## Facts

- Game: PolyTrack 0.6.3, free, browser-based, WebGL.
- Genres: racing, arcade, level editor.
- Platforms: any modern browser including Chromebooks; touch controls on mobile.
- Cost: free, no account, no advertising on this mirror.
